purpose: Populate the three-plane cardinal House from existing governed Rooms and holdings, then add a small curated landmark layer for religious, mythic and project-symbolic wayfinding.
rules: Project-native operators and Rooms take visual precedence; comparative subjects remain one disclosure layer farther out unless a reader explicitly enters Traditions/Comparison.
Population records do not change knowledge ownership.
The compass shows landmarks sparingly; Room detail may show more; archive-only nodes stay out of primary navigation.
Plane is reading orientation, direction is subject family, Tree zone is ecological/functional placement, and depth is navigation specificity.
Named religious/mythic figures remain rooted in their own traditions and dated receptions before comparative or Potatoverse mapping.
Tree of Life and Tree of Strife classify reproduced relation-patterns, not the moral essence of people, religions, deities or cultures.
Named religious/mythic population is curated in religious-symbolic-branch-atlas.json; the compass should link to it rather than duplicate its full node set.

visibility_levels.landmark: May appear directly in spatial navigation.
visibility_levels.room-detail: Shown only after selecting a direction/plane or opening a Room.
visibility_levels.archive-only: Indexed for deep retrieval but omitted from default spatial UI.
